de: Boilers of the steamboat Louisiana explode as she pulls back from the dock in New Orleans, killing more than 150 people.

t: 切罗基民族的奴隶起义开始了.
te: A slave revolt in the Cherokee Nation commences.
dz: 切罗基民族的奴隶起义开始了.
de: A slave revolt in the Cherokee Nation commences.

t: 泽布伦中尉 派克在洛基山脉的科罗拉多山脚下发现山峰。 它后来被命名为"派克斯峰"以示他的荣誉.
te: Lieutenant Zebulon Pike spots a mountain peak while near the Colorado foothills of the Rocky Mountains. It is later nam…
dz: 派克远征:泽布伦中尉 派克在洛基山脉的科罗拉多山脚下发现山峰。 它后来被命名为"派克斯峰"以示他的荣誉.
de: Pike Expedition: Lieutenant Zebulon Pike spots a mountain peak while near the Colorado foothills of the Rocky Mountains. It is later named Pikes Peak in his honor.

t: 经过 16 个月的辩论，大陆会议批准了《邦联条例》。
te: After 16 months of debate the Continental Congress approves the Articles of Confederation.
dz: 美国独立战争：经过 16 个月的辩论，大陆会议批准了《邦联条例》。
de: American Revolutionary War: After 16 months of debate the Continental Congress approves the Articles of Confederation.

dz: 瓦莱塔第二所建造的Castellania在内部的Sorrows礼拜堂的祝福下正式落成.
de: The secondly-built Castellania in Valletta is officially inaugurated with the blessing of the interior Chapel of Sorrows.

t: 哈布斯堡帝国和丹麦在兹西波克战役中从匈牙利取得对库鲁克人的军事胜利.
te: The Habsburg Empire and Denmark win a military victory over the Kurucs from Hungary in the Battle of Zsibó.
dz: 拉科克齐独立战争:哈布斯堡帝国和丹麦在兹西波克战役中从匈牙利取得对库鲁克人的军事胜利.
de: Rákóczi's War of Independence: The Habsburg Empire and Denmark win a military victory over the Kurucs from Hungary in the Battle of Zsibó.

te: Prince William III of Orange lands a Dutch army at Brixham, beginning the 1688 invasion of England to challenge the rul…
dz: 奥兰治亲王威廉三世在布里克森姆登陆了一支荷兰军队,从1688年入侵英格兰来挑战国王詹姆斯二世的统治,并发动了会导致光荣革命的事件.
de: Prince William III of Orange lands a Dutch army at Brixham, beginning the 1688 invasion of England to challenge the rule of King James II and setting in motion the events that would lead to the Glorious Revolution.

t: 弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗抵达印加帝国首都库斯科。
te: Francisco Pizarro arrives in Cuzco, the capital of the Inca Empire.
dz: 弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗抵达印加帝国首都库斯科。
de: Francisco Pizarro arrives in Cuzco, the capital of the Inca Empire.

t: 由弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗指挥,埃尔南多·德·索托手下的西班牙征服者在卡哈马卡外与因坎皇帝阿塔胡阿帕…
te: Commanded by Francisco Pizarro, Spanish conquistadors under Hernando de Soto meet Incan Emperor Atahualpa for the first…
dz: 西班牙征服印加帝国:由弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗指挥,埃尔南多·德·索托手下的西班牙征服者在卡哈马卡外与因坎皇帝阿塔胡阿帕相会,于次日安排在市广场相会.
de: Spanish conquest of the Inca Empire: Commanded by Francisco Pizarro, Spanish conquistadors under Hernando de Soto meet Incan Emperor Atahualpa for the first time outside Cajamarca, arranging for a meeting in the city plaza the following day.

t: 施威泽·艾德格诺森夏夫特在莫尔加滕战役中伏击了利奥波德一世的军队.
te: The Schweizer Eidgenossenschaft ambushes the army of Leopold I in the Battle of Morgarten.
dz: "老瑞士邦联"的成长:施威泽·艾德格诺森夏夫特在莫尔加滕战役中伏击了利奥波德一世的军队.
de: Growth of the Old Swiss Confederacy: The Schweizer Eidgenossenschaft ambushes the army of Leopold I in the Battle of Morgarten.

t: 默西亚的彭达被诺森布里亚的奥斯维乌所击败.
te: Penda of Mercia is defeated by Oswiu of Northumbria.
dz: 温瓦德之战:默西亚的彭达被诺森布里亚的奥斯维乌所击败.
de: Battle of the Winwaed: Penda of Mercia is defeated by Oswiu of Northumbria.
